result.reason: The added subsection gives Company a 30-day written-notice convenience right covering the Agreement and active Statements of Work, eliminates termination charges, and requires refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period. Contractor’s existing convenience right applies only when no Statement of Work remains uncompleted, so it cannot terminate during an active committed engagement. The change is narrowly focused and preserves the breach-termination framework. Drafting is professional, though “forfeiture of any amounts” and termination “in part” of the Agreement are somewhat imprecise.
